methods.name: dupEach
methods.summary: Return a new List whose elements are repeated n times. The receiver is unchanged.

methods.summary: Return a new List whose elements are in rotated order. Negative n values rotate left, positive n values rotate right. The receiver is unchanged.

methods.summary: Returns a new List whose elements are repeated sequences of the receiver, up to size length. The receiver is unchanged.
